name: CameraDetailPanel
intent: Floating detail for one camera — its fields plus the violations it caught, as a selectable list.
when: A camera selected on a map needs its record and everything it caught
The violation list is the entry point to individual tickets
A camera preview or live stream sits alongside what the camera caught

chooseOver.because: ObservationDetailPanel is one ticket. CameraDetailPanel is the level above it — the camera and the list of tickets it accounts for, which drills into the ticket panel.

commonMistakes: Giving the camera panel a different width from the ticket panel — the frame visibly jumps when drilling in and back. Both default to 340.
Letting a future stream player size the preview — the 16:9 frame, rounding and clipping belong to the panel. Pass the player as `preview` and let it fill the box.

configSchema: stub — enumerate config props from source
